}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Beagleboard logo, "BeagleV-Ahead", and "v1.0 04/23/2023" are silkscreened on board top.
{{See also|BeagleBoard Devices|List of SBCs}}
The board can be powered by 2 different methods: *Female micro USB 3.0 port *5V/2A via barrel
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Alibaba T-Head]] TH1520 ''Xuantie'' C910 @2.0GHz :SoC: Quad-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 4.0 TOPS @INT8 @1.0GHz *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXM-4-64 :(OpenGL ES3.1, OpenVG 1.2, Vulkan 1.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp75, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp40 *Storage: 16GB (eMMC) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *Wi-Fi:[[AMPAK]] AP6203BM ([[Broadcom]] BCM430132) :Wi-Fi 4 (1T1R 802.11abgn) + Bluetooth 5.2 *USB: 1x micro USB 3.0 (OTG) port *Expansion: mikroBUS shuttle connector, :2× 46-pin BeagleBone Cape headers *Power: 5V/2A via barrel or micro USB 3.0 (OTG)
